summary: Contractor exit: comprehensive privilege audit, credential revocation, and equipment clearance
description:
Issue summary: External contract ML engineer (GitHub: ajones-contract) is completing engagement on 2026-03-15. Need coordinated removal of privileges, revocation of long-lived tokens, verification of no orphaned service accounts, and pickup/receipt of company laptop.

Impact: Potential security risk if credentials/laptop remain active. Business risk for data residency and billing if service accounts continue to run workloads. HR requires confirmation of asset return for final contractor invoice.

Relevant identities and assets:
- Contractor name: Alex Jones (external consultant)
- GitHub username: ajones-contract (member of org/team: infra, serving-runtime)
- Okta email: alex.jones@contractors.redwood.ai (member of groups: rwd-engineers, vpn-users)
- VPN username: ajones-vpn
- GCP console: owner on project redwood-research-poc (sa: ajones-research-sa@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com)
- AWS role assumed occasionally: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/contractor-infra
- CI/CD tokens: GitHub Actions runner labeled runner-contract-03 with secret GH_ACTIONS_RUNNER_TOKEN_ajones (rotatable)
- Laptop: RWD-LAP-271, MacBook Pro (serial: C02XQ0XXXXX), currently in possession of contractor; scheduled pickup 2026-03-16

Desired outcome: All interactive and machine credentials removed or rotated; service accounts handed to owning teams or disabled; GitHub membership revoked; Okta account suspended; VPN access disabled; laptop collected, inspected, wiped, and re-enrolled or returned to IT asset pool; confirmation to HR that offboarding checklist is complete.

Steps to reproduce / verify (for auditing):
1) Confirm Okta suspension results in failed login after 5 minutes.
2) Confirm VPN termination prevents tunnel establishment.
3) Attempt GitHub access with revoked account (should be 404/403).
4) Ensure CI runners no longer pick up runner-contract-03 jobs.
5) Verify no active GCP workloads running under ajones SA and list billing usage for project redwood-research-poc last 30 days.

Evidence/logs: Links to audit dashboards and logs requested below in related_confluence_pages and linked_issues.

Notes: Contractor flagged a potential lingering S3 pre-signed URL used by a small PoC; security wants a search and revoke if found.
investigation_notes:
Initial reconnaissance by IT found active GitHub SSH keys and two personal access tokens (PAT) created in last 90 days. SRE found a running notebook in redwood-research-poc with CPU usage spikes (not high cost but owned by ajones-research-sa). Security flagged GH_ACTIONS_RUNNER_TOKEN_ajones as long-lived and not rotated. HR reported laptop pickup scheduled but asked for escalation if physical pickup delayed beyond 2026-03-18.

Hypotheses: 1) Contractor left residual CI runner and PATs used for automated test jobs. 2) Service account may be used by scheduled cron job owned by research team. 3) Pre-signed URL mention could be an ad-hoc share; search required across S3 logs and bucket policies.

Preliminary risk: Medium-High due to cross-account permissions and presence of long-lived tokens.
